text:
sam: UX quick take: add a keyboard shortcut to bulk-approve in Prompt Sets (e.g., Shift+A) so power users can approve without reaching for the mouse. also want to fix low-contrast pill in scorecard header.
maria: shortcut makes sense but we need discoverability: show tooltip on bulk toolbar and list in Help modal. +1 on contrast.
asha: a11y rules: (1) shortcuts must be opt-in or documented and not interfere with browser/OS shortcuts, (2) announce actions to SRs via aria-live, (3) high-contrast focus ring on pill.
kevin: implementation notes: will add configurable shortcut and visual hint. question: what should SR announce when shortcut triggers bulk-approve?
maria: final SR message should be concise: "Approved 8 prompt sets. Press Undo to revert." keep aria-atomic true. don't announce intermediate counts.
jessica: contrast: pill uses brand green on white currently fails AA. propose darker green #0f7a3a and 2px focus ring with 3:1 inner padding. Tooltip text: "Shift+A: Approve selected" and include in keyboard help.
asha: SR test flow: select items, press Shift+A, assert SR reads final message, Tab to Undo, Enter to revert, assert SR reads "Reverted 8 prompt sets." Also test that focus returns to bulk toolbar after Esc.
ui-bot: Added shortcut docs to /help/keyboard-shortcuts and flagged in changelog.
kevin: I'll add unit tests for shortcut registration, e2e for NVDA/VoiceOver smoke, and update color tokens. will PR today.
maria: acceptance criteria: (1) configurable keyboard shortcut visible in help, (2) accessible SR announcements via aria-live role=status aria-atomic=true, (3) contrast-passing pill with focus styles, (4) Undo keyboard path and focus return. assign @kevin to implement, @asha to write SR tests, @jessica for visual spec. Thanks!
